title.value: Doubly Right Object Recognition: A Why Prompt for Visual Rationales
title.justification: This is the title of the paper as provided in the initial description.
title.quote: Doubly Right Object Recognition: A Why Prompt for Visual Rationales Chengzhi Mao1 Revant Teotia1 Amrutha Sundar1 Sachit Menon1 Junfeng Yang1 Xin Wang2 Carl Vondrick1 1 2 Columbia University Microsoft Research

extractions.description: The paper explores the capability of computer vision models to not only predict object categories correctly but also provide accurate rationales for these predictions. It proposes a 'doubly right' object recognition benchmark, using a 'why prompt' to transfer verbal rationales from language models into visual models, enhancing their explanatory capabilities.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the explainability of visual recognition models rather than addressing any specific Climate Change issues.
climate_change_is_central.quote: In this paper, we investigate whether computer vision models can also provide correct rationales for their predictions.
